privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: DRAFT — This text is pending legal review.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.body: This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect when you use Ticketify, how we use it, who we share it with, and what rights you have over it. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 2. Data We Collect
sections.body: We collect the data you give us directly: your email address, your name, and the tickets and receipts you upload or scan in the app. We also store data generated by your use, such as categories, budgets, households and preferences. When you purchase the Pro subscription, we receive purchase confirmation from the app store.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of Processing
sections.body: We use your data to provide the service: syncing your tickets across devices, computing your budgets and statistics, and managing your account. We also use aggregated and anonymous data to improve the app. Legal document acceptance records are kept to meet our audit obligations.

sections.title: 4. Third Parties
sections.body: To operate the service we work with trusted providers: Supabase hosts the database and handles authentication; RevenueCat manages in-app subscriptions; and Apple App Store and Google Play process payments. These providers process your data only to provide their services and under our instructions.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
sections.body: We keep your data while your account is active and for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes of this policy. Legal document acceptance records are kept immutably for audit purposes. When you delete your account, your data is erased, except where we must keep it by law.

sections.title: 6. Account Deletion
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings in the app. Deleting your account erases your tickets, budgets, households and related data. Cancelling your paid subscription is handled separately from the app store.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, export and delete your personal data, and to object to or restrict its processing. You can export your data from the app or contact us through the channel listed below to exercise any of these rights.

sections.title: 8. Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or about how we process your data, email us at [contact@ticketify.app]. Please note this is a draft: the final version will be published after legal review.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using Ticketify you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

sections.title: 2. Service Description
sections.body: Ticketify lets you keep track of your purchases by scanning or uploading receipts, set monthly budgets per category and view statistics about your spending. If you create or join a household, your data is shared with the members of that household.

sections.title: 3. Your Account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for the activity that happens on your account. You may not use the app for illegal activities or to upload false information or third-party data without authorization.

sections.title: 4. Subscriptions and Payments
sections.body: The Pro subscription is billed through the app store and renews automatically until you cancel it. You can cancel at any time from the store; access to Pro features continues until the end of the paid period.

sections.title: 5. License to Use
sections.body: We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the app in accordance with these terms. You may not copy, modify, distribute or commercially exploit the app or its content.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The app is provided 'as is'. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from its use. You enter your own tickets and budgets: verify your data before making decisions based on it.

sections.title: 7. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms when necessary. Changes are announced in the app and take effect from the date of the new version. If you keep using the app after a change, you are considered to have accepted the new version.

sections.title: 8. Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic. Any dispute arising from their use is submitted to the competent courts of the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: For questions about these terms, email us at [contact@ticketify.app]. This text is a draft pending legal review.

consentGateBody: To continue using Ticketify you need to accept the updated Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions.
